items.Sentence: A new headworks will be constructed... It will have a self-cleaning screen and a bypass channel with a manual bar screen.
one complete mix pond ... will have a surface area of about 0.3 of an acre and will have a capacity of about 0.8 million gallons.
two partial mix ponds... All of the ponds will be equipped with aerators... All three ponds will be active and operated in series.
The existing WWTF, percolation/evaporation ponds, and land application areas are in Assessor’s Parcel Number (APN) 053-090-11.
Effluent will be discharged to a series of new disposal (evaporation/percolation) ponds installed in two phases.
